issues.title: C phase1/phase2 independence from A/B is not cryptographically or temporally demonstrated
issues.analysis: The hash chain proves which C answers and records are present, and the seal precedes C reveal. It does not prove that C could not read A/B. Both raw A/B phase2 reviews existed before C phase1 was sealed, and the A/B interagreement report existed before C phase2 records were written. The notes are an assertion, not an independently verifiable access-control fact.
issues.impact: The required fresh-adjudicator independence cannot be certified, so this proposal cannot be promoted to trusted gold even if every mechanical binding remains intact.
issues.remediation: Create an append-only or signed C phase2 seal containing the full semantic hash and completion timestamp before A/B artifacts or their interagreement report become accessible; preserve access-control/audit evidence and then rerun adjudication.

issues.title: N05/N06/N07 exact-hash accepted sets are structurally sound but not a closed defensible answer space

N05.problem: The unchanged source is accepted despite Rewrite, while a natural until paraphrase is omitted.

N06.problem: Open wording admits additional exact pairs; eight cross-aspect pairs are also contestable as exact active/passive counterparts.

N07.problem: The second order is marked but defensible; exact punctuation variants remain unaccepted because punctuation is not canonicalized.

issues.analysis: The independent verifier recomputed every text hash, normalized hash, set hash, duplicate guard, and MULTIPLE_TEXTS order invariance. Those mechanics pass. The failure is semantic closure: exact-byte accepted sets cannot exhaust these open constructed prompts, and at least one accepted N05 response does not perform the requested rewrite.
issues.impact: A future reviewer can submit a grammatical meaning-preserving response and fail blind exact agreement solely because its bytes were not enumerated. The final labels therefore remain unsafe as a scoring oracle.
issues.remediation: Either replace exact enumeration with a reviewed semantic/constraint canonicalizer, define a genuinely closed construction grammar including punctuation policy, or remove these items from any certifying gold set.

issues.title: RCAL2-N01 concrete finding directly reverses the authorized notice

evidence.authorizedSource: Saturday morning brings a railing-inspection closure, and the path below stays open.
evidence.recordedFinding: The evidence supports canonical option 3: the upper path remains open while the lower path closes.

issues.analysis: The recorded concrete finding states the opposite path/bridge status. The mapped option and reveal still independently support an F/fatal synchronization defect, but the adjudication evidence is internally false.
issues.impact: The adjudication record cannot be treated as a faithful evidence trail, and its downstream hash merely commits the contradiction.
issues.remediation: Correct the finding to state that the bridge closes while the path below remains open, independently re-review the item, and regenerate adjudication/proposal/report hashes.

issues.title: RCAL2-B02 concrete finding invents delay and manipulation claims absent from the revealed explanation

evidence.revealedExplanation: Requiring two sensors mathematically guarantees that no future leak can be missed and that false alarms are impossible.
evidence.recordedFinding: The revealed explanation falsely claims the protocol makes delay, error, and manipulation impossible.

issues.analysis: The explanation is indeed fatally false, but the rationale expands it into claims about delay and manipulation that were never made. This is posterior embellishment rather than concrete evidence.
issues.impact: The final F/fatal decision remains supportable, but this rationale line is not evidence-faithful.
issues.remediation: Replace the finding with the two actual unsupported guarantees and regenerate all bound hashes after independent review.

limitations: Filesystem timestamps are observations, not trusted timestamp attestations.
A passing author validator proves deterministic equality to its hard-coded adjudication constants, not the truth of those constants.
Past network/API/DB/secret activity fields in the source report are declarations; this audit independently made none of those accesses.
The private trusted-gold file was neither read nor modified, so this audit makes no claim about its bytes or contents.
